counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of other possible diagnoses
No evidence of other conditions that could cause similar symptoms
decisive_items: A subcutaneous nodule of approximately 1 cm diameter was present under the hypogastrium.
Revealed endometrial glands consisting of a single layer of monomorphous cuboidal cells with an endometrial stroma
response.rationale: The presence of a subcutaneous nodule near a scar and the history of myomectomy, combined with the histopathological features of the nodule, strongly support the diagnosis of abdominal wall endometrioma.
